title: Modern Bungalow — New Construction Permit Set
scope: Cover sheet and drawing index
Lot and building site plan with sun-shadow study
Four exterior elevations
Foundation plan with slab and footing details
First floor plan with 3D overview
description: Complete permit drawing set for a four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bath new construction residence with a detached garage and living quarters above. The set carries the project through from cover sheet and site analysis to foundation details and dimensioned floor plans, drawn to submit.

title: Six-Storey Civic Building — SketchUp Model and Site Context
scope: Massing and façade modelling from site photography
Tiled hip roof forms and tower elements
Balcony and sun-shading detail
Landscaped site, roads and boundary treatment
Matched aerial viewpoints for comparison
description: Three-dimensional model of an existing six-storey civic building, built from site photography and survey information. The model reproduces the tiled roof forms, recessed balconies and tower elements, and sits in a modelled site so views can be matched against the original photographs.

title: Bachelor View — Contemporary Hillside Residence
scope: Project summary sheet with renderings
Site and disturbance plan with pool and retaining wall
Sun-shadow study and utility legend
Four exterior elevations with keyed notes
Daylight basement and main floor plans
description: Permit documentation for a contemporary hillside residence with a daylight basement, swimming pool and retaining structures. The site and disturbance plan sets out grading, setbacks and utilities, and the elevation sheets carry keyed exterior notes for review.

title: Chic Cottage — Two-Storey Residence, Full Construction Set
scope: Title page rendering and sheet index
Four exterior elevations
First and second floor plans with 3D layout views
Basement plan and basement floor framing
First floor and second floor ceiling framing with 3D framing model
Electrical and HVAC plans for all levels
description: Construction documentation for a two-storey shingled cottage, taken past permit stage into framing and building services. Floor framing, ceiling framing and a three-dimensional framing model accompany the electrical and HVAC layouts, giving the builder a coordinated set rather than plans alone.

title: Rural Farmstead — Scan-to-BIM Existing Conditions
scope: Registered point cloud of farmhouse and barn range
Existing-conditions Revit model
Roof geometry and dormer forms
Site topography and boundary
description: Existing-conditions BIM model of a rural farmstead — a stone farmhouse with an attached barn range — built from a registered point cloud. The model captures the irregular roof geometry and wall alignments of the existing fabric, giving a reliable base for renovation or extension design.

title: Three-Storey Commercial Building — As-Built BIM from Laser Scan
scope: Point-cloud registration and clean-up
Building envelope and floor levels
Roof plant and mechanical equipment
Parking, paving and landscape context
description: As-built Revit model of a three-storey commercial building produced from laser scan data. Roof-mounted mechanical plant, parking layout and surrounding landscape are modelled alongside the building envelope, so the file works for refurbishment planning as well as documentation.

title: Heritage and Residential Scan-to-BIM Conversions
scope: Point cloud to Revit conversion for a historic theatre façade
Masonry villa modelled with interior room layout
Multi-storey street-front building with measured elevations
Cutaway sections through modelled interiors
description: A set of scan-to-BIM conversions across building types: an ornate historic theatre façade, a masonry villa modelled through to interior room layout, and a multi-storey street-front building documented with measured elevations. Each was built from registered point cloud data and cut back to show the modelled interior.

title: Multi-Unit Residential Development — Town Planning Set
scope: Neighbourhood and site characteristics plan
Design response plan with written site description
Demolition plan
Ground floor plan for all dwellings
Two streetscape elevations
Shadow-cast studies at 9am, 11am, 1pm and 3pm
Site area and coverage analysis table
description: Town planning submission for a multi-dwelling residential development on a 738 m² corner allotment. The set answers the planning authority point by point — neighbourhood character, design response, overshadowing across the day, site coverage — alongside the demolition plan and streetscape elevations.

title: Hillside Residence Addition — Sloping Site
scope: Existing residence modelled from supplied information
Topographic site model with contours and cut
Proposed addition integrated with the existing dwelling
Four elevations against natural ground line
Dimensioned main floor plan
description: Proposed addition to an existing residence on a steeply sloping site. The topography was modelled so the addition could be set against natural ground level, and the elevations show the relationship between existing and new across the fall of the land.
